text: まいあさ　はやおき　して　かえった　さなぎを　がんばって　そだてて　たんだ！

structure.jp: まいあさ　はやおき　して
かえった　さなぎを
がんばって　そだてて　たんだ！
structure.en: I was working hard raising it!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on over a period; てた is the short spoken form with い dropped. そだてて　た = 'was raising'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. かえった　さなぎ = 'the pupa that hatched'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (spoken form of のだ) at the end gives an explaining, emotional 'you see' feeling. そだてて　たんだ = 'I was raising it, you see!'.
